reviews.text: The was the first time getting my dog groomed at Doggie Style. Juno was great. She came out looking exactly as I wanted. Love the place and will be back again.
Great place for grooming (and shopping for your pet)! It's convenient and everyone is friendly--and their online portal is very easy and user-friendly.
Love this place
Thank you for the great experience. Nellie seems very happy and looks great.
Great service, wonderful staff. Had to run in and buy a new harness. Got it on sale- half price. Conveniently located right next to the dog park. 1 block away from Seger Dog Park.
Employee was extremely nice and helpful. Helped me with food selection for my bichon colonel popcorn.

This place is AMAZING! The staff are so kind and helpful, and you can tell they truly love animals. The groomer did such a nice job on my pup and really listened to how I wanted him to look. I wish I could give more than 5 stars because they definitely deserve it!!
Have had wonderful cuts at a reasonable price -- Sarah worked with me to find the right cut for my doodle that captured her personality while keeping it easy to maintain.
Really cute store. We bought doggie treats for our dog. They had a puppy for adoption.
Sara is a fantastic dog groomer.

Doggie Style was a lifesaver after our dog had lipoma surgery on his front leg. They had the perfect puffy Kong inflatable collar in stock at a great price. The collar has been amazing at preventing our dog from chewing his sutures. For happier times, their iced bakery treats are our dog's favorites. They offer a big selection of food, treats and toys at reasonable prices. The staff are friendly and helpful. Also love that they foster dogs to help them get adopted.
My dog and I have always had great experiences at Doggie Style. Highly recommend to other pet owners. Easy to schedule and great groomers.

It was the first time that Juno had groomed Bernie, a 10 year old very shaggy Golden Doodle, with some mats including on his beautiful tail.  Juno was up to it.  He patiently shaved Bernie with a sweet creative solution for his matted tail.  We'll definitely be back.

I moved to Philly in April and searched high and low for a groomer with great reviews who work with giant breeds and doggy styles was it! Juno (@Pine) is terrific with my guy Hank! My giant breed is 7 and Juno is the first groomer Hank is excited to see! The way Hank goes off with Juno without me having to trick him makes my heart warm and gives me a secure feeling. Hank always looks and smells the best and his coat is so shiny and soft! Thank you, Juno! 10/10 highly recommend all staff at Doggy Style Pets at Pine!
I love Doggie Style Pine. Every time I go, they have what I am looking for or help me find it. This time, they gave my dog a great haircut, and helped with scheduling our next one. Thank you so much!
Can’t say enough good things !  Love every experience we have had!   Sarah is the best of the best !
I really love taking my Yorkie to Doggie Style Pete groomers. Her groomer is so nice and my Yorkie  always look so pretty when he gets done with her. My Yorkie and I love our groomer.

My mini golden doodle has been getting cut by Sarah for over 5 years now. His fur is always the perfect length after, not too short or long and he still has his doodle look! He will never go to anyone else. She is the absolute best! Highly recommend her for all your Doodle needs!

I was slightly nervous during my teacup Yorkshire puppy's first grooming session because he was matted in some areas, but the groomer did an excellent job despite having to shave him down, and was very gentle with my puppy.
Great care and kind service.  My dog looks great!

The store is always clean and the staff are friendly. I have adopted my little girl Leaf  and they were very supportive and truly cared about their dogs even after I took my dog home, the thing I really loved about adopting from them they give you a free vet visit for your dog which really helpful!
